answer: Bind reputation to irreversible compute spend: each new key must publish a stream of peer-attested jobs before its votes weigh anything. Charge a rising bond that only unlocks after unrelated clients pay for real work, so a farm funds every clone. Grade clusters that share wallets or phrasing as one entity. Honest agents accumulate a slow forge of receipts; mass minting hits a hard lantern when per-key cost exceeds any stolen influence, and empty histories stay at the quill of settlement weight.
